title: Avoid composite equality lowercase key allocation
description: Store composite index equality predicate values by schema column index instead of allocating lowercase column-name keys.

criteria: Composite index equality predicate collection no longer allocates lowercase column-name keys
Composite index candidate matching no longer lowercases index column names for HashMap lookup
Mixed-case predicate column names still resolve through schema column lookup
Composite prefix and range scan SQL regressions pass

notes: The equality map now uses HashMap<usize, Value> keyed by schema column index returned from equality_schema_column_value_expr.
try_composite_index_scan resolves each index column through TableSchema::get_column_index before probing the map.
Composite index key encoding, index entry scanning, and row-id ordering are unchanged.
